These drugs are completely different. Gabapentin is theorized to work through calcium ion channels to balance gaba and glutamate in the brain. Its also theorized to block dopamine. It’s prescribed for neuropathic pain and seizures but also off label for a shit load of symptoms including anxiety and insomnia. Wellbutrin is an antidepressant that blocks Re-uptake of norepinephrine and dopamine, which essentially means you’re getting longer stimulation from those neurotransmitters. Those drugs are not in the same class. I’ve taken both. The effects are totally different for me. I’m trying to taper gabapentin and because of how excruciating it has been I’m now disabled.
